resources.name: The League of Moveable Type
resources.description: An open-source digital type foundry with a curated catalog of display and text typefaces. Each font is hand-crafted and free for personal and commercial projects, focusing on quality over library size.

resources.name: Collletttivo
resources.description: An open-source type collective designing contemporary Italian typefaces. A rotating group of designers builds and releases experimental and display fonts collaboratively, free for personal and commercial use.

resources.name: Google Fonts
resources.description: A massive directory of open-source web fonts and variable typefaces, alongside the Material Symbols icon set. Quality across the catalogue is hit-or-miss, but it remains the most widely supported font repository on the web.

resources.name: FontShare
resources.description: A curated typography service from Indian Type Foundry offering professional-grade fonts at no cost. The catalog is smaller than general repositories, but individual typefaces are generally more polished and technically consistent.

resources.name: Velvetyne
resources.description: A French, community-run type foundry dedicated to free and open-source typography. Its catalog leans heavily toward experimental, expressive display type and multilingual scripts, developed collaboratively by independent designers.

resources.name: Bye Bye Binary
resources.description: A Franco-Belgian collective creating and distributing inclusive, non-binary and post-binary typefaces. The project explores typographic glyphs and ligatures designed specifically for gender-inclusive French and multilingual writing.

resources.name: Open Source Publishing
resources.description: A Brussels-based graphic design collective building libre fonts and publishing tools. Its catalog is shaped by public workshops, digital typography experiments, and a strict commitment to free software workflows.

resources.name: Wordmark
resources.description: A browser-based font preview tool that renders custom text across every font installed on your computer simultaneously. It helps you compare weights and letterforms quickly without loading fonts into design software.

resources.name: Mockups Design
resources.description: A collection of layered PSD mockups organized by category, including packaging, business cards, apparel, and signage. The templates use smart objects and feature more realistic lighting and staging than generic template packs.

resources.name: Poly Haven
resources.description: A public library of scan-based PBR textures, HDRIs, and 3D models. While built primarily for 3D workflows, its high-resolution texture maps and surface photos work equally well for 2D background work and compositing.

resources.name: Ambient CG
resources.description: A dedicated repository of public-domain PBR material scans and procedural surface maps. It focuses strictly on seamless textures rather than full 3D assets, providing complete PBR map sets with diffuse, normal, roughness, and displacement channels.

resources.name: Texture Labs
resources.description: A library of high-resolution photographic textures, overlays, and atmospheric effects. The collection leans toward paper grain, print decay, and grunge surfaces, designed as practical design overlays rather than 3D PBR materials.

resources.name: Public Domain Image Archive
resources.description: A curated online archive of out-of-copyright artworks, historical illustrations, and vintage photography. Assets are hand-picked from museum and library digitization programs, available as high-resolution scans for unrestricted use.

resources.name: NYPL Digital Collections
resources.description: An extensive digital archive of prints, photographs, maps, manuscripts, and illustrations digitized from The New York Public Library collections. It offers high-resolution downloads of historical visual material in the public domain.

resources.name: Transparent Textures
resources.description: A web utility providing seamless, transparent tileable textures alongside ready-to-use CSS background presets. You can preview texture patterns live over custom background colors and copy the resulting CSS snippet directly.

resources.name: Krita
resources.description: A professional raster graphics editor tailored specifically for digital painters, concept artists, and illustrators. It features advanced brush engines, stabilizer tools, layer management, color management with CMYK support, and frame-by-frame 2D animation.

resources.name: Photopea
resources.pricing_note: Free with ads, paid to remove them
resources.description: A browser-based raster graphics editor that serves as an alternative to Photoshop. It runs entirely inside the browser, supports PSD, XCF, Sketch, and XD formats, and reproduces familiar layer, adjustment, and masking workflows.

resources.name: RawTherapee
resources.description: A non-destructive raw photo developer designed for in-depth photographic post-processing. It provides an advanced 32-bit floating-point processing pipeline, demosaicing algorithms, detailed color grading, and lens aberration correction.

resources.name: GIMP
resources.description: An extensible raster graphics editor for image manipulation, photo retouching, and graphic design. It provides comprehensive layer management, customizable brushes, selection tools, and scripting support across major operating systems.

resources.name: Aseprite
resources.pricing_note: Buy a key, or build the source yourself for free
resources.description: A dedicated sprite and pixel-art editor built for game artists and animators. It features timeline-based animation, onion skinning, custom color palettes, and tilemap modes. Precompiled binaries require a license, but the source code is freely compilable.

resources.name: LibreSprite
resources.description: A community fork of Aseprite maintained from its last open-source release. While it lacks some of the newer upstream features, it offers a reliable and straightforward pixel-art editor with frame animation and layer support.

resources.name: Snapseed
resources.description: A mobile photo editor developed by Google featuring professional-level editing tools in an accessible touch interface. It includes selective adjustment brushes, curves, perspective correction, healing tools, and non-destructive raw file editing.

resources.name: Affinity
resources.description: A professional creative suite covering vector illustration, photo retouching, and desktop publishing. Built as a free alternative to Illustrator & InDesign with Canva AI integration, it operates with a one-time purchase and no subscription.

resources.name: theSVG
resources.description: A comprehensive library of company and brand logos provided in scalable SVG format. Each entry includes multiple variations, including color, monochrome, dark mode, and isolated wordmarks, with no attribution required for downloads.

resources.name: Vecteezy
resources.description: A marketplace of vector illustrations, design templates, and stock graphics. While the free tier requires attribution and has download limits, the library is extensive and worth digging through for UI elements, backgrounds, and icons.

resources.name: Flaticon
resources.description: A large searchable repository of vector icons and stickers across numerous design styles. While much of the platform is behind a paid subscription, it provides a sizable free collection of high-quality interface icons and monochrome brand marks.

resources.name: FontForge
resources.description: A dedicated typeface editor and converter for creating and modifying fonts at the vector outline level. It supports Bézier curve editing, kerning tables, OpenType feature programming, and batch conversion across major font formats.

resources.name: Graphite
resources.description: An early-stage vector graphics and raster compositing editor built around non-destructive, node-based procedural workflows. It combines traditional canvas drawing tools with procedural graph generation directly inside desktop or browser environments.

resources.name: VectorPea
resources.description: An in-browser vector graphics editor from the creator of Photopea designed as a lightweight alternative to Illustrator. It opens and exports AI, SVG, and PDF files directly in the browser with familiar pen, path, and layer tools.

resources.name: Inkscape
resources.description: A professional-grade vector illustration program built natively on the W3C SVG standard. It provides comprehensive path manipulation, node editing, text formatting, boolean operations, and an active ecosystem of extensions for technical and artistic illustration.

resources.name: Calligra Karbon
resources.description: A component of the KDE Calligra office and creative suite for vector drawing and page design. It offers a straightforward interface for working with paths, gradient fills, text layouts, and shapes, making it a simple alternative to complex illustration suites.

resources.name: Canva
resources.pricing_note: Free, with paid options; requires an account
resources.description: A template-driven graphic design platform built for quickly producing social media graphics, presentations, and marketing collateral. It provides an extensive drag-and-drop asset library, collaborative editing, and simplified layout tools that require no technical design experience.

resources.name: Adobe Color
resources.pricing_note: Needs an Adobe account to save
resources.description: A color palette generator and exploration platform built around traditional color harmony rules. It includes accessibility contrast checkers, color blindness simulators, a searchable community library, and direct export options into Adobe Creative Cloud applications.

resources.name: Coolors
resources.description: A fast, keyboard-driven color scheme generator for designers. You can lock chosen hues and tap spacebar to generate harmonized palettes, extract colors from uploaded photos, check contrast ratios, and browse thousands of community-submitted palettes.

resources.name: Color Hunt
resources.description: A curated feed of four-color palettes hand-picked for web and graphic designers. It focuses on trendy, harmonious color combinations categorized by mood and theme, allowing users to browse, like, and copy hex codes instantly.

resources.name: Colormind
resources.description: A color scheme generator powered by deep learning trained on color styles from photography, cinema, and classic art. You can lock specific colors while the model predicts cohesive complementary shades, or extract balanced palettes from uploaded images.

resources.name: Color Hex
resources.description: A quick-lookup color reference tool providing detailed breakdown data for any hex code. It generates monochromatic shades, tints, complementary harmonies, color space conversions, and copy-paste CSS code snippets for text, borders, and shadows.

resources.name: Huemint
resources.description: A machine learning color palette generator that tests color schemes against realistic UI, illustration, and branding mockups. Instead of showing abstract swatches, it previews hierarchy and contrast in real time on websites, posters, and graphic elements.

resources.name: AnyGradient
resources.description: A modern CSS gradient editor supporting perceptual color spaces such as OKLCH and Display-P3. It prevents muddy middle tones in multi-stop blends and exports clean CSS code optimized for modern high-gamut displays.

resources.name: FeralUI Gradient Builder
resources.description: An interactive gradient preview and design tool for studying how color ramps behave across varying geometric shapes and backdrops. It allows designers to test lighting illusions, surface curvature, and color transitions under controlled visual conditions.

resources.name: are.na
resources.description: A collaborative research and curation platform free of algorithms, advertisements, and social metrics. Users organize visual bookmarks, text snippets, links, and PDFs into open channels, making it popular for conceptual design and collective research.

resources.name: Cosmos
resources.description: A visual curation and bookmarking tool structured around an infinite, minimalist image grid. It features color-based filtering and tag clustering, offering a clean, distraction-free environment for gathering design inspiration and building moodboards.

resources.name: Behance
resources.description: Adobe's creative showcase platform where professionals share detailed project case studies across branding, illustration, UI design, and photography. It serves as both a public portfolio hub and a comprehensive directory for discovering contemporary design work.

resources.name: Pinterest
resources.description: The most widely used visual discovery and moodboarding platform, offering an immense catalog of images and ideas. While its algorithmic feed can be repetitive and heavily ad-driven, its collaborative boards and visual search remain standard for collecting references.

resources.name: Branding Styleguides
resources.description: A specialized digital archive collecting authentic brand guidelines, style manuals, and design systems from established companies worldwide. It is a practical reference for identity designers studying logo usage rules, typography hierarchies, and corporate design standards.

resources.name: Fonts in Use
resources.description: A public typography archive documenting fonts used in real-world graphic design projects, book covers, packaging, and posters. The index is searchable by typeface, format, historical period, and industry, providing historical and practical typographic context.

resources.name: Savee
resources.description: A minimalist, ad-free visual bookmarking platform built specifically for designers and art directors. Like Cosmos, it serves as an alternative to Pinterest with a clean, image-first interface, browser extension capture, and zero algorithmic clutter.

resources.name: PureRef
resources.pricing_note: Pay what you want, free for personal use
resources.description: A lightweight standalone desktop utility for collecting and arranging reference images on an infinite canvas. It features a borderless window that stays pinned on top of painting or 3D applications, with minimal memory overhead.

resources.name: Anytype
resources.description: A local-first, privacy-focused knowledge management and note-taking application built on peer-to-peer architecture. It organizes notes, documents, and databases into customizable relational objects that remain encrypted and fully accessible offline.

resources.name: Logseq
resources.description: A privacy-first, open-source outliner and knowledge base that stores notes locally as plain Markdown or Org-mode files. It organizes ideas into a bi-directional knowledge graph with daily journals, task tracking, and flashcards.

resources.name: Kdenlive
resources.description: An open-source non-linear video editor built on the MLT framework and KDE libraries. It supports multitrack timeline editing, color grading, audio mixing, proxy clips, and a wide variety of video formats as a free alternative to Premiere.

resources.name: Blender
resources.description: A comprehensive open-source 3D creation suite that doubles as a powerful motion graphics tool. While designed primarily for 3D modeling and animation, its node-based compositor and Grease Pencil vector tools make it a capable free alternative to After Effects.

resources.name: DaVinci Resolve
resources.description: An industry-standard non-linear video editing suite renowned for advanced color grading and digital audio post-production. The free version combines editing, Fusion visual effects, and Fairlight audio mixing into a complete production studio.

resources.name: Glaxnimate
resources.description: A lightweight vector animation editor designed for exporting animations to web and mobile formats like Lottie and animated SVG. Its timeline and shape-tweening workflow functions closer to a free After Effects and Bodymovin setup than to traditional Adobe Animate.

resources.name: Freesound
resources.description: A collaborative online database of audio snippets, sound effects, instrument samples, and ambient field recordings. All sounds are uploaded by creators and indexed with detailed tags, acoustic descriptions, and filterable Creative Commons licenses.

resources.name: Free SFX
resources.description: A sound effect library offering royalty-free audio tracks and foley clips across diverse categories. Users can preview and download audio for games, video projects, and multimedia productions, though commercial usage requires attribution.

resources.name: Audacity
resources.description: An open-source, multi-track audio recorder and waveform editor. It is widely used for podcast production, voiceovers, audio restoration, and audio format conversion, offering essential effects, spectral analysis, and broad VST plugin support.

resources.name: 8 Bit Composer
resources.description: A browser-based chiptune synthesizer and music tracker modeled after classic 8-bit sound chips. It allows composers to sequence retro melodies and sound effects directly in the browser across multiple voice channels.

resources.name: LMMS
resources.description: A cross-platform digital audio workstation designed for producing music and sequencing beats. It features a tracker-style song editor, piano roll, built-in synthesizers, sound effect plugins, and support for VST instruments and SoundFont soundbanks.

resources.name: ChipTone
resources.description: A browser-based procedural sound generator built for synthesizing retro 8-bit sound effects for video games. It features preset buttons for jumps, lasers, explosions, and coin pickups, with intuitive sliders for fine-tuning frequencies and pitch bends.

resources.name: Twinmotion
resources.pricing_note: Free for revenue under $1M/year; requires an Epic account
resources.description: A real-time architectural visualization tool powered by Unreal Engine. It allows architects and designers to transform CAD and BIM models into photorealistic stills, panoramas, and immersive walkthroughs with dynamic lighting, seasons, and animated foliage.

resources.name: Blockbench
resources.description: A specialized low-poly and voxel 3D modeling program tailored for pixel-art textures and blocky game assets. It includes dedicated workflows for Minecraft entity modeling, skeletal rigging, frame animation, and export to popular game engines.

resources.name: Materialize
resources.description: A standalone utility for generating complete PBR texture map sets from a single source photograph. It creates height, normal, metallic, roughness, and ambient occlusion maps with interactive preview controls to adjust surface depth and edge bevels.

resources.name: Kenney
resources.description: An extensive public repository containing tens of thousands of modular game assets, including 2D sprites, 3D models, UI kits, audio clips, and fonts. Released under CC0, it is the standard starting point for game jam prototypes and indie projects.

resources.name: OpenGameArt
resources.description: A community portal hosting free 2D sprites, 3D models, music tracks, and sound effects for game developers. Because submissions come from independent contributors, you must check each asset's license individually since it isn't uniformly CC0 like Kenney.

resources.name: LÖVE
resources.description: A lightweight 2D game framework built around Lua, providing fast execution without a graphical editor. Its minimal learning curve and clean API make it a popular framework for rapid prototyping, game jams, and small 2D indie titles.

resources.name: Phaser
resources.description: A fast open-source 2D game framework designed for HTML5 browser games using Canvas and WebGL rendering. It is worth a look if you want a link-and-play web build instead of a native install.

resources.name: Godot
resources.description: A feature-rich open-source game engine supporting both dedicated 2D workflows and modern 3D rendering. It uses a flexible node-based scene hierarchy and scriptable GDScript or C#, making it the closest free alternative to Unity.

resources.name: Unity
resources.pricing_note: Free under $200K/yr revenue or funding, paid tiers above
resources.description: An industry-standard commercial engine for 2D and 3D, C# scripting, and multi-platform compilation. It features a vast ecosystem, mature profiling tools, and an expansive commercial Asset Store and community.

resources.name: GameMaker
resources.pricing_note: Free for non-commercial use, $99.99 one-time for commercial
resources.description: A 2D-focused engine with drag-and-drop logic alongside its native GML scripting language. Renowned as the engine behind Undertale, Hotline Miami, and Hyper Light Drifter, it excels at fast 2D development.

resources.name: GDevelop
resources.description: A no-code, event-based 2D engine that uses visual event sheets to build gameplay mechanics without programming. It serves as a gentler starting point than Godot or GameMaker if you'd rather not write code yet.

resources.name: Construct 3
resources.description: A browser-based no-code 2D engine with drag-and-drop event sheets and instant previewing. The free tier caps events and layers, and full access needs a subscription, but it provides rapid in-browser prototyping.

resources.name: Defold
resources.description: A lightweight 2D-focused engine built by King, utilizing Lua scripting and generating tiny builds. It provides zero setup and strong performance, making it especially strong for mobile and web games.

resources.name: Tiled
resources.description: An engine-agnostic tile map editor, worth having regardless of which engine you land on for room-based or tile-based level design. It exports clean JSON and XML formats across major game frameworks.

resources.name: LDtk
resources.description: An entity-driven level editor from the Dead Cells designer, complements Tiled rather than replacing it, better suited to placed objects than large tile grids. It includes built-in auto-tiling rules and clean JSON exports.

resources.name: WPS Office
resources.description: A cross-platform office productivity suite containing alternatives to Word, PowerPoint, and Excel with integrated AI document tools. It provides strong file compatibility with Microsoft Office formats, tabbed document browsing, and built-in PDF editing tools.

resources.name: LibreOffice
resources.description: A free and open-source office suite developed by The Document Foundation. It provides complete desktop replacements for Microsoft Office, including Writer, Calc, Impress, and Draw, with native support for OpenDocument standards and Microsoft formats.

resources.name: Google Drive
resources.description: A cloud storage and collaborative productivity platform hosting Google Docs, Sheets, and Slides. It provides nice alternatives to Microsoft Office with real-time document collaboration, version history tracking, and seamless cloud syncing.

resources.name: Zen Browser
resources.description: A Firefox-based desktop browser built around vertical tabs, collapsible sidebars, and customizable split-view workspaces. The workflow might seem a bit odd at first but once you get the hang of it, you don't go back from it, though DRM support is broken on windows.

resources.name: Firefox
resources.description: A privacy and freedom first web browser built on an independent engine rather than Chromium. It features enhanced tracking protection, extensive extension customizability, and a faster and lighter engine than chromium browsers.

resources.name: Brave Browser
resources.description: A privacy-focused web browser that blocks ads and trackers by default. Built on Chromium, it provides broad web compatibility without Google tracking integrations, alongside optional web3 and rewards features.

resources.name: uBlock Origin
resources.description: A content blocker that is efficient and highly configurable with low memory overhead. Chrome only gets uBlock Origin Lite since Google pulled the full version after the Manifest V3 switch, noticeably weaker filtering than the Firefox version.

resources.name: Privacy Badger
resources.description: From the EFF, learns to block invisible trackers automatically based on their behavior rather than relying on a manual filter list. It analyzes third-party web requests dynamically as you browse.

resources.name: Decentraleyes
resources.description: Serves common libraries (jQuery, etc.) locally instead of fetching them from third-party CDNs. It blocks a common tracking vector without breaking sites that depend on those CDNs, speeding up delivery.

resources.name: Don't track me Google
resources.description: Strips Google's click-tracking redirect wrapper from Search and Maps links. Clicking or copying a result gives you the real URL directly without recording intermediate tracking pings.

resources.name: PhotoCraft
resources.description: An open-source image editor written entirely in Rust. It covers layers, masks, adjustment layers, layer styles, type, vectors and brushes, with the menus, shortcuts and panels you already know. Native on desktop, with a web build you can host yourself.

resources.name: VectorCraft
resources.description: A vector illustration app built in pure Rust, with the pen tool, panels and shortcuts illustrators already work with. Native on desktop, with a web build you can host yourself.

resources.name: FilmCraft
resources.description: A video editor rebuilt from scratch in Rust, with no FFmpeg inside. Open source and aimed at professional editing work, with native desktop builds and a web build you can host yourself.

resources.name: LightCraft
resources.description: A photo library and raw developer that runs on your machine, written from scratch in Rust. Organize your photos and develop raw files locally, with no subscription.

resources.name: PdfCraft
resources.description: A native PDF app for reading, organizing, combining, splitting and securing PDFs. It runs fully on your machine, with no account, no telemetry and no cloud.

resources.name: EffectCraft
resources.description: Open-source motion graphics and visual effects, built in pure Rust. Native on desktop, with a web build you can host yourself.

resources.name: DesignCraft
resources.description: Page layout and publishing software rebuilt in pure Rust. It has spreads, parent pages, threaded stories, styles, swatches, text wrap and a paragraph composer, and exports print-ready PDFs. No subscription, no license server and no telemetry.

resources.name: FigCraft
resources.description: Interface design and prototyping in a native app that opens instantly and works offline. It covers frames, auto layout, components, vector networks, variables and prototypes.

resources.name: TextureCraft
resources.description: A 3D texture painting app. Paint PBR materials directly onto 3D models in layers with masks, bake mesh maps, and export textures for game engines and other tools. Open source and works offline.

resources.name: MaterialCraft
resources.description: A node-based tool for building tileable PBR materials from noises, patterns and filters. It previews the result live in 2D and 3D and exports maps for game engines and other software.

resources.name: WordCraft
resources.description: A fast word processor that reads and writes .docx files. It has a ribbon, styles, tables, track changes, references and mail merge, and works offline.

resources.name: SoundCraft
resources.description: A digital audio workstation for recording, editing and mixing, built from scratch in Rust. Open source and free on every platform it supports.

resources.name: DeckCraft
resources.description: A presentation app that builds and delivers slide shows, and opens and saves .pptx files. Written in pure Rust, with no subscription and no cloud.

resources.name: GridCraft
resources.description: A native spreadsheet app that reads and writes .xlsx files. It includes PivotTables, charts and more than 500 calculation functions.
